notes.title: Miracle Heroes: Official Open-Source Release!
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

After a year of meticulous development, we are excited to announce that Miracle Heroes: Time Treasure Hunter is officially live! This distinctive multiplayer light rogue-like adventure game will take you on a thrilling journey through time and space, filled with unknown challenges and endless possibilities.

Open Source Project Now Available on FAB Marketplace
Alongside the game's release, our open-source project is now available on the FAB Marketplace. As a mature commercial project framework, this type of offering is quite rare on FAB. We warmly encourage Unreal Engine developers to explore our project—it’s completely free. For commercial use, you can purchase the professional-grade assets to support us. Thank you for your continued support!

This project is well-suited for both beginners and advanced developers looking to elevate their skills. We hope it will be a valuable resource for you.

Project Highlights
Controller Support: Fully compatible with gamepad controls.
Local Split-Screen and Online Co-Op: Up to three players can team up.
Mod Support via GameFeatures: Flexible and robust mod integration.
Expandable Game Framework: Designed for ease of development and scalability.
Please note that while our project does not include C++ source code for certain plugins, these plugins are optional and will not affect the core framework's functionality. They mainly provide utility functions such as saving systems and object pooling (as also utilized in our No One Survives project).

Open Source Project vs. Mod Development
Our open-source project differs slightly from the Steam ModKit tools due to adjustments made to comply with FAB Marketplace requirements. We hope these differences won’t impact your mod development experience and invite you to explore the possibilities!
